art_direction: 浅海沫底，下眼缘轻轻抬起，左眼更眯，笑意藏在眼睛里。
composition_variation: Use two gently upturned curved openings with raised lower edges, left more closed than right. Upper lids are broad but light in pressure with no downward inner slopes. Center the large pupils, leaving matching color at the lower outside rims. The smile is carried by subtle curves alone. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
